items.name: Decoder
items.summary: A low‑level, push‑based decoder from Avro bytes to Arrow `RecordBatch`.

methods.name: batch_is_empty
methods.summary: Returns true if the decoder has not decoded any batches yet (i.e., the current batch is empty).

methods.name: batch_is_full
methods.summary: Returns true if the decoder has reached its capacity for the current batch.

methods.name: batch_size
methods.summary: Returns the configured maximum number of rows per batch.

methods.name: capacity
methods.summary: Returns the number of rows that can be added to this decoder before it is full.

methods.name: decode
methods.signature: fn decode(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> Result<usize, AvroError>
methods.summary: Feed a chunk of bytes into the decoder.

methods.name: flush
methods.summary: Produce a `RecordBatch` if at least one row is fully decoded, returning `Ok(None)` if no new rows are available.

methods.name: schema
methods.summary: Returns the Arrow schema for the rows decoded by this decoder.

items.name: Reader
items.summary: A high‑level Avro **Object Container File** reader.

methods.name: avro_header
methods.summary: Returns a reference to the parsed Avro container‑file header (magic, metadata, codec, sync).

methods.name: schema
methods.summary: Returns the Arrow schema discovered from the Avro file header (or derived via the optional reader schema).

items.name: ReaderBuilder
items.summary: A builder that configures and constructs Avro readers and decoders.

methods.name: build
methods.signature: fn build<R: BufRead>(self, reader: R) -> Result<Reader<R>, ArrowError>
methods.summary: Build a `Reader` (OCF) from this builder and a `BufRead`.

methods.name: build_decoder
methods.summary: Build a streaming `Decoder` from this builder.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Creates a new `ReaderBuilder` with defaults:

methods.name: use_utf8view
methods.summary: Returns whether `StringViewArray` is enabled for string data.

methods.name: with_active_fingerprint
methods.summary: Sets the initial schema fingerprint for stream decoding.

methods.name: with_batch_size
methods.summary: Sets the **row‑based batch size**.

methods.name: with_projection
methods.summary: Sets an explicit top-level field projection by index.

methods.name: with_reader_schema
methods.summary: Sets the **reader schema** used during decoding.

methods.name: with_strict_mode
methods.summary: Enable stricter behavior for certain Avro unions (e.g., `[T, "null"]`).

methods.name: with_tz
methods.summary: Sets the timezone representation for Avro timestamp fields.

methods.name: with_utf8_view
methods.summary: Choose Arrow's `StringViewArray` for UTF‑8 string data.

methods.name: with_writer_schema_store
methods.summary: Sets the `SchemaStore` used to resolve writer schemas by fingerprint.
